style.backgroundSystem: deep pine green gradient #1C4A3C for hero and trust screens, warm champagne gold gradient #EFD9A7 for infographic screens, dark rustic wood #3E2F23 for scene screens
style.iconSystem: thin gold-line icons and thin-line cloud ornaments only, single gold accent
style.lightingSystem: soft warm studio light with a gentle top light and soft contact shadows, food renders moist and matte with visible natural texture, never plastic or over-glossy
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium Chinese-gourmet dried-seafood ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep pine green #1C4A3C, warm champagne gold gradient #EFD9A7, clean white #FFFFFF, one cinnabar red accent #B03028 and one gold text accent #D4AF37; soft warm studio lighting with a gentle top light and soft contact shadows, food always renders moist, matte and natural with visible texture, never plastic or over-glossy; bold modern sans-serif headlines in gold or charcoal only; consistent rounded-corner info labels and thin gold-line dividers; consistent thin gold-line icon and ornament style; high-end food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; product always arranged on a clean white plate #FFFFFF with stable scale and placement; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking food.
style.presentationRules: product always arranged on a clean white plate #FFFFFF, stable scale, centered or plate-anchored placement across the set
style.surfaceSystem: white ceramic plate #FFFFFF on dark pedestal or weathered dark wood board #3E2F23
style.typography: bold modern sans-serif headlines in gold #D4AF37 or charcoal #2D2D2D only, labels 10-14pt
